verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a documented RESTful GitBook API and a GitBook CLI that can build and publish integrations, so programmatic development against GitBook is possible. No official language SDK or client library is named anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit official SDKs or client libraries (e.g., JS/TS or Python packages), SDK documentation and reference, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with an SDK.
